footprint.notes: Lilly's FY2025 10-K names production states and countries without figures (major production sites in Indiana, North Carolina, Puerto Rico and Wisconsin; Ireland, France, Spain, Italy, China and Japan) and says approximately 27,000 of about 50,000 employees at the end of 2025 were outside the U.S.; the U.S. remainder is not stated, so it is not derived. Investment figures come from Lilly's press releases at lilly.mediaroom.com (the press-release host linked from lilly.com/news/press-releases) and a lilly.com story. Lilly states state-wide totals only for North Carolina (roughly $4 billion since 2020, as of January 2023), Wisconsin ($4 billion total planned, December 2024) and Indiana (more than $21 billion since 2020, as of May 2026). The press-release index was checked on 2026-11-24 for newer state-wide totals: none found for North Carolina or Wisconsin (the 2026 groundbreaking releases for Houston, Richmond and the Lehigh Valley list the North Carolina and Wisconsin sites without amounts), and the May 2026 Indiana figure is still the newest. The three state values come from different dates, are not a common snapshot, and were not summed or adjusted. Lilly has also announced sites in Virginia ($5 billion, September 2025), Texas ($6.5 billion, September 2025), Puerto Rico (more than $1.2 billion, October 2025), Alabama ($6 billion, December 2025) and Pennsylvania's Lehigh Valley ($3.5 billion at its November 2026 groundbreaking); each figure is for a single site and Lilly has published no state-wide total for those states, so they are not recorded as state values, and they are not added as sites in this refresh. The February 26, 2025 release reports $50 billion of U.S. capital commitments since 2020, with no per-state split. Headquarters and the employee row are re-sourced to the FY2025 10-K; the other sites keep their release sources.
